description: Twelve 2/0 E-AC-3 frames at 48 kHz like those of eac3-signal-aht, whose bins of the pointer 4 (vector quantization with the 32 vectors of Table E.3.4) use every row of the table at least once, row 30 included (A/52 Annex E 3.4.2).

skip.skip_insertion: The check rewrites E-AC-3 frames with skip fields.
skip.decode: FFmpeg 6.1.1 reads the vector of a hebap 4 bin from the next row of Table E.3.4 (docs/development.md, "E-AC-3 decoding"), so its samples are no reference here.
